name: Python Pickle Lab
description: Isolated Python environment for pickle deserialization research. Demonstrates __reduce__ gadgets, REDUCE opcode injection, and custom Unpickler defenses.

name: Java Serialization Lab
description: Java deserialization research environment. Includes vulnerable Commons Collections versions and ysoserial-style gadget chain demonstrations.

name: .NET ViewState Lab
description: .NET BinaryFormatter and ViewState deserialization research. Demonstrates MAC bypass, ObjectDataProvider gadgets, and TypeConfuseDelegate chains.

name: ML Model Security Lab
description: ML model supply chain security research. Analyzes PyTorch .pt files, scikit-learn .pkl files, and demonstrates safetensors as a safe alternative.

name: Callback Simulator Lab
description: Out-of-band callback interception simulator. Captures simulated DNS, HTTP, RMI, and LDAP callbacks that deserialization payloads would trigger in real scenarios.
